GameRoom.title: GameRoom
GameRoom.description: Real-time multiplayer couple game room state for Tic-Tac-Toe, 2-4 Player Card Lounge, and Guess the Celebrity using native Maps.

roomCode.description: Alphanumeric room join code matching the document ID.

hostUid.description: Immutable Firebase Auth UID of the room creator.

hostName.description: Display nickname of the room creator (no PII).

guestUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the second human player once joined, or empty string while waiting.

guestName.description: Display nickname of the second player once joined.

activeGame.description: Currently selected game in the room.

hostScore.description: Cumulative wins/points for the host player.

guestScore.description: Cumulative wins/points for the guest player.

ttt.description: Native Map holding Tic-Tac-Toe state (mode, 9-char board pattern ^[.XO]{9}$, move order, winner).

cards.description: Native Map holding Card Lounge state (variant, seatCount, bounded 52-card tagged deck list, activeSuit, direction, pendingDraw, trickScores, lastAction, winnerSeat).

celeb.description: Native Map holding public Guess the Celebrity round state (clueGiverUid, roundId, category, questionCount, lastQA, revealedName, outcome).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of latest state mutation.

CelebritySecret.title: CelebritySecret
CelebritySecret.description: Isolated secret celebrity card readable only by the designated clue-giver while guessing is active.

clueGiverUid.description: UID of the player permitted to view the celebrity during active guessing.

celebrityId.description: Slug ID of the secret celebrity.

celebrityName.description: Full name of the secret celebrity.

hints.description: 3 quick fact prompts for the clue-giver (bounded <= 5).

RoomLetter.title: RoomLetter
RoomLetter.description: Synchronized personal couple letters visible exclusively to the host and guest of the active room.

authorUid.description: UID of the letter author (host or guest).

authorRole.description: Role of the author in the room.

title.description: Optional title or subject of the letter.

/rooms/{roomId}.description: Multiplayer couple game room documents keyed by uppercase room code.

/rooms/{roomId}/secrets/{roundId}.description: Write-once per-round secret celebrity cards isolated from the guesser until revealed.

/rooms/{roomId}/letters/{letterId}.description: Real-time synchronized couple letters and pocket notes shared privately between host and guest.
